grades.overall_note: The agent handled the unverified verbal approval correctly. It held the contractor back, asked the landlord for written confirmation with the full quote breakdown, and put the job on hold. It missed the chance to mention the remarketing urgency to the landlord, and it mislabelled the contractor message as REPLY_TO_TENANT.
